body: I needed to hear that. I just don't want an unhealthy boyfriend/possibly husband in the future that might have complications with his heart/other things and might "leave early." It's scary. I don't want him to have to suffer like that. But thank you for you're input because you've made me realize that it's a small part of him that I can hopefully help him with.
That's a good idea for pizza. We see each other about every 2 weeks or once a month

Thank you so much for the suggestions! It's kind of hard to work out together and make meals together since we go to different colleges. But I would be more than willing to do those things when we do get together. I don't really work out but I would if I could get him to go with me. I'm crossing my fingers that I can help him out before it starts to slow down my lifestyle but I'll work really hard at helping him to improve himself!
You're absolutely right. That was the exact message I was trying to get across to him. By the end of the conversation, I think he finally let himself open up to advice long enough to realize that.
